title: LongVideoBench: A Benchmark for Long-context Interleaved Video-Language Understanding
authors_zh: Haoning Wu 等（官方来源未披露机构）
paper_type_zh: NeurIPS 2024 Datasets and Benchmarks Track 的 benchmark / evaluation surface
best_for_zh: 关注 benchmark、评分契约、污染风险、评测 harness 和后训练反馈可复用性的研究者。
one_line: LongVideoBench exposes long video-language QA with referred-context reasoning as an auditable evaluation surface.
LongVideoBench 把需要指代上下文推理的长视频语言问答做成可审计的评测面。
why: Stresses temporal retrieval plus multimodal reasoning.
inclusion_reason: Stresses temporal retrieval plus multimodal reasoning.

title: Problem
问题
html: LongVideoBench asks how to evaluate video-language models on long videos where answering requires locating and combining evidence across time, subtitles, and visual content. The primary sources are the 2024 arXiv paper, official project site, GitHub repository, Hugging Face dataset, and NeurIPS 2024 Datasets and Benchmarks listing on the project page. Its decision boundary is long-context multimodal evaluation, not video pretraining data or a video agent environment. A benchmark item contains a video or video reference, duration metadata, question, multiple-choice options, answer key, and referred-context evidence fields. The atlas value is the explicit temporal evidence surface for long multimodal reasoning.

LongVideoBench 关注的是：视频语言模型在长视频中是否能跨时间、字幕和视觉内容定位并组合证据。主要来源是 2024 年 arXiv 论文、官方项目页、GitHub 仓库、Hugging Face 数据集，以及项目页标注的 NeurIPS 2024 Datasets and Benchmarks 状态。它的边界是 long-context multimodal evaluation，不是视频预训练数据，也不是视频 agent 环境。一个样本包含视频或视频引用、时长元数据、问题、多个选项、答案键和 referred-context 证据字段。对 atlas 的价值是提供显式的长视频时序证据评测面。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The contribution is a long-video multiple-choice QA benchmark with interleaved video-language context and referred-context annotations. The core mechanism is to collect long videos, create questions whose answers require specific temporal evidence, provide candidate options, and score model choices against a fixed answer key. The data object is a video QA instance, not a frame-level caption dataset or free-form video summary. The feedback contract is answer-level multiple-choice accuracy, with evidence fields useful for audit but not replacing the final answer key. Closest comparisons include short-video QA and image-centric multimodal benchmarks; LongVideoBench changes duration, temporal grounding, and multimodal evidence requirements.

核心贡献是一套长视频 multiple-choice QA benchmark，包含 interleaved video-language context 和 referred-context 标注。机制是收集长视频，构造需要特定时序证据才能回答的问题，给出候选选项，并用固定答案键给模型选择打分。数据对象是 video QA instance，不是逐帧 caption 数据，也不是自由视频摘要。反馈契约是 answer-level 多选 accuracy，证据字段可用于审计但不替代最终答案键。最接近的对照是短视频 QA 和以图像为中心的多模态 benchmark；LongVideoBench 改的是视频时长、时序定位和多模态证据要求。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Inputs: long web videos or video references, subtitles or language context where available, human-written questions, answer options, gold answers, and referred-context annotations.
  2. Pipeline: collect videos, segment or index temporal content, write questions that depend on relevant moments, validate options and answers, release dataset records, and evaluate model choices.
  3. Outputs: multiple-choice predictions, accuracy by model and subset, and dataset artifacts on GitHub/Hugging Face.
  4. Feedback contract: a model receives credit when its selected option matches the gold answer for that item.
  5. Reproducibility notes: pin dataset version, video availability, frame sampling rate, subtitle use, context-window policy, prompt template, option order, model video encoder settings, and whether evidence annotations are used only for analysis or as model input.

1. 输入：长网络视频或视频引用、可用字幕/语言上下文、人工问题、候选选项、gold answer 和 referred-context 标注。
  2. 流程：收集视频，分段或索引时序内容，编写依赖相关片段的问题，验证选项和答案，发布数据记录，再评测模型选择。
  3. 输出：多选预测、按模型/子集聚合的 accuracy，以及 GitHub/Hugging Face 上的数据 artifact。
  4. 反馈契约：模型选择的选项与该 item 的 gold answer 一致即得分。
  5. 复现字段：必须固定数据版本、视频可用性、抽帧率、是否用字幕、context-window 策略、prompt 模板、选项顺序、视频编码器设置，以及证据标注是只用于分析还是输入模型。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The paper and project page report a public benchmark with thousands of long videos and thousands of human-authored QA items, and the official artifacts expose code and Hugging Face data. The central empirical claim is that long-video understanding remains difficult for contemporary multimodal models, especially when relevant evidence is sparse across time. Row-level evidence is the multiple-choice answer key: the selected option is correct or incorrect. Evidence boundaries include video availability, sampling policy, subtitle handling, option order, and whether the model sees full video, sampled frames, transcripts, or referred-context fields. Accuracy does not by itself prove faithful temporal grounding.

论文和项目页报告了包含数千个长视频、数千个人工 QA 的公开 benchmark，官方 artifact 提供代码和 Hugging Face 数据。核心实证结论是：当相关证据在时间上稀疏分布时，当代多模态模型的长视频理解仍然困难。单条证据是多选答案键：模型选项正确或错误。证据边界包括视频是否仍可访问、抽样策略、字幕处理、选项顺序，以及模型看到的是完整视频、抽帧、转写文本还是 referred-context 字段。Accuracy 本身不证明模型忠实进行了时序定位。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The prior baseline is short-video QA, image-based VQA, or long-context text benchmarks without a real video substrate. LongVideoBench changes the object by combining long-duration video, language context, multiple-choice QA, and referred temporal evidence in one release. The direction signal is that multimodal long-context evaluation needs video availability, sampling, subtitle, and evidence-window metadata. The quality signal is the official paper, project page, code, and dataset release. What is not new: multiple-choice QA, video QA, and accuracy scoring. Before reuse, inspect video licenses, takedown risk, subtitle provenance, frame sampling, option artifacts, split policy, and contamination after public release.

已有基线多是短视频 QA、图像 VQA，或没有真实视频基底的长文本 benchmark。LongVideoBench 改变的是对象：把长时长视频、语言上下文、多选 QA 和 referred temporal evidence 放进同一个 release。方向信号是多模态长上下文评测必须记录视频可用性、抽样、字幕和证据窗口元数据。质量信号来自官方论文、项目页、代码和数据发布。并不新的部分包括多选 QA、视频 QA 和 accuracy 评分。复用前要检查视频许可、下架风险、字幕 provenance、抽帧策略、选项 artifacts、split 策略和公开后的污染。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Correctness is answer-key correctness, not guaranteed evidence faithfulness. A model may choose the right option from priors, language cues, or option artifacts without using the intended video segment. Video availability and decoding can change over time, especially for web-sourced media. Results depend heavily on frame sampling rate, temporal coverage, transcript availability, modality budget, and prompt format. Referred-context annotations help audit temporal grounding but can leak answer-relevant information if used as input. The benchmark should not be read as a general video-agent environment or as proof of robust long-horizon visual memory.

正确性是 answer-key correctness，不保证证据忠实性。模型可能靠先验、语言线索或选项 artifacts 选对，而没有使用目标视频片段。网络视频的可用性和解码结果会随时间变化。结果强烈依赖抽帧率、时序覆盖、转写可用性、模态预算和 prompt 格式。Referred-context 标注有助于审计时序 grounding，但如果作为输入也可能泄漏答案相关信息。这套 benchmark 不能被当成通用 video-agent 环境，也不能证明模型有稳健长程视觉记忆。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use LongVideoBench as a schema for long multimodal evaluation records: preserve video id or reference, duration, frame sampling policy, subtitle/transcript availability, question, options, gold answer, referred context, split, model input policy, and score. It is useful for audits that separate retrieval of the relevant time span from answer selection. For atlas use, it shows how a benchmark can combine human-authored questions with objective multiple-choice scoring while still needing evidence-grounding checks.

LongVideoBench 可作为长多模态评测记录的 schema：保留 video id/引用、时长、抽帧策略、字幕/转写可用性、问题、选项、gold answer、referred context、split、模型输入策略和分数。它适合做把“找到相关时间段”和“选择答案”分开的审计。对 atlas 来说，它展示了 benchmark 如何把人工问题与客观多选评分结合，同时仍然需要证据 grounding 检查。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Keep answer accuracy and temporal grounding separate. The answer key tells whether the option is correct; referred context helps ask whether the model could have used the right evidence. Read sampling and transcript policies before comparing models. A text-only or sparsely sampled setup may measure different behavior from full-video understanding.
要把答案 accuracy 和时序 grounding 分开。答案键说明选项是否正确；referred context 用来追问模型是否可能使用了正确证据。比较模型前先看抽样和转写策略。纯文本或稀疏抽帧设置测到的行为，可能不同于完整视频理解。
